001package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog;
002
003import org.apache.commons.lang3.Validate;
004import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.annotations.HistoryLogProps;
005import com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.helpers.Bytes;
006
007/**
008 * Part of the burst of records 488-497 the Tandem Mobi writes every two hours. Each covers the two
009 * hours since the previous burst; the counts below were compared with the requests TandemKit
010 * logged in 161 such windows on two pumps (the maintainer's and a tester's).
011 *
012 * The class name is provisional: opcode 492 is not in Tandem's cloud event schema or the Mobi
013 * app's history log list. Fields not named here have not been identified and are exposed raw.
014 */
015@HistoryLogProps(
016    opCode = 492,
017    displayName = "Control Request Counters"
018)
019public class ControlRequestCountersHistoryLog extends HistoryLog {
020
021    private long controlRequestCount;
022    private long unknown14;
023    private long unknown18;
024    private long unknown22;
025
026    public ControlRequestCountersHistoryLog() {}
027    public ControlRequestCountersHistoryLog(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long controlRequestCount, long unknown14, long unknown18, long unknown22) {
028        super(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum);
029        this.cargo = buildCargo(pumpTimeSec, sequenceNum, controlRequestCount, unknown14, unknown18, unknown22);
030        this.controlRequestCount = controlRequestCount;
031        this.unknown14 = unknown14;
032        this.unknown18 = unknown18;
033        this.unknown22 = unknown22;
034    }
035
036    public int typeId() {
037        return 492;
038    }
039
040    /**
041     * <table border="1">
042     * <caption>Parsed fields for ControlRequestCountersHistoryLog:</caption>
043     * <tr><td><code>controlRequestCount</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10)</code></td></tr>
044     * <tr><td><code>unknown14</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14)</code></td></tr>
045     * <tr><td><code>unknown18</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18)</code></td></tr>
046     * <tr><td><code>unknown22</code></td><td><code>Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22)</code></td></tr>
047     * </table>
048     */
049    public void parse(byte[] raw) {
050        Validate.isTrue(raw.length == 26);
051        this.cargo = raw;
052        parseBase(raw);
053        this.controlRequestCount = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 10);
054        this.unknown14 = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 14);
055        this.unknown18 = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 18);
056        this.unknown22 = Bytes.readUint32(raw, 22);
057    }
058
059    public static byte[] buildCargo(long pumpTimeSec, long sequenceNum, long controlRequestCount, long unknown14, long unknown18, long unknown22) {
060        return HistoryLog.fillCargo(Bytes.combine(
061            HistoryLog.typeIdBytes(492, 0),
062            Bytes.toUint32(pumpTimeSec),
063            Bytes.toUint32(sequenceNum),
064            Bytes.toUint32(controlRequestCount),
065            Bytes.toUint32(unknown14),
066            Bytes.toUint32(unknown18),
067            Bytes.toUint32(unknown22)));
068    }
069
070    /**
071     * Equal to the number of CONTROL-characteristic requests the phone sent in the window in
072     * 161 of 161 windows, and to unknown18 + unknown22 in every record.
073     *
074     * @return CONTROL requests received in the window
075     */
076    public long getControlRequestCount() {
077        return controlRequestCount;
078    }
079
080    /**
081     * 0 in every record.
082     *
083     * @return raw uint32 at offset 14
084     */
085    public long getUnknown14() {
086        return unknown14;
087    }
088
089    /**
090     * The CONTROL requests not counted in {@link #getUnknown22()} (temp rate, bolus, suspend,
091     * resume and fill requests in the checked windows).
092     *
093     * @return raw uint32 at offset 18
094     */
095    public long getUnknown18() {
096        return unknown18;
097    }
098
099    /**
100     * Equal to the number of DismissNotification, SetMaxBasalLimit and SetMaxBolusLimit
101     * requests in the window in 161 of 161 windows. What sets these apart is unknown.
102     *
103     * @return raw uint32 at offset 22
104     */
105    public long getUnknown22() {
106        return unknown22;
107    }
108}
